dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Meow... meow..."
dialogues.text: "Meow... meow..."

dialogues.jp:
桜の木に手を当てながら、さくらが小さく悲し
そうに鳴いている。
dialogues.en: Putting her hand on a cherry tree, Sakura cries quietly.
dialogues.text: Putting her hand on a cherry tree, Sakura cries quietly.

dialogues.jp: 冗談めかした単語なのに、とても暗い。
dialogues.en: It sounds like a joke, but she looks very sad.
dialogues.text: It sounds like a joke, but she looks very sad.

dialogues.jp:
校内のどこにも居場所がなくて、音夢の携帯に
留守電をいれて桜並木に｛たたず／佇｝んでいた。
dialogues.en:
There was nowhere I could stay at school, so I left a
message on Nemu's cell phone and stood under the cherry
trees.
dialogues.text:
There was nowhere I could stay at school, so I left a
message on Nemu's cell phone and stood under the cherry
trees.

dialogues.jp: 夜桜はきれいだ。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossoms are really beautiful at night.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossoms are really beautiful at night.

dialogues.jp: 「かったる」
dialogues.en: "What a pain."
dialogues.text: "What a pain."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「Ｓｏｒｒｙ……せっかくの卒業式だったのに」
dialogues.en: "Sorry about the graduation ceremony."
dialogues.text: "Sorry about the graduation ceremony."

dialogues.jp:
とん、と振り返ってそのまま木に背中を預けて、
さくらが頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Sakura turns around, bows, and leans back against the tree.
dialogues.text: Sakura turns around, bows, and leans back against the tree.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、かったるいって言うのはただの口癖だぞ
　……いや、ただのでもないが」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, that's just my pet phrase, actually it's not just,
but..."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, that's just my pet phrase, actually it's not just,
but..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うんん。ボクが音夢ちゃんを挑発したのがい
　けないんだ」
dialogues.en: "No, I shouldn't have provoked Nemu-chan like that."
dialogues.text: "No, I shouldn't have provoked Nemu-chan like that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Provoked?"
dialogues.text: "Provoked?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ボクがお兄ちゃんから離れろって」
dialogues.en: "She wanted me to get away from you."
dialogues.text: "She wanted me to get away from you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「？　なんだそれ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: 身体を真っ直ぐさくらのほうに向ける。
dialogues.en: I turn to face Sakura.
dialogues.text: I turn to face Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃんには分かってたんだよ……うんん。
　ボクが分かるように言っていたんだ」
dialogues.en: "I knew... yeah. I knew what Nemu-chan was saying."
dialogues.text: "I knew... yeah. I knew what Nemu-chan was saying."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんから離れろって……私にしか分からな
　いように」
dialogues.en: "She gave me a sign to get away from you."
dialogues.text: "She gave me a sign to get away from you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: すっ、と音夢が桜並木に姿を現す。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, Nemu's here in the row of cherry blossom trees.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, Nemu's here in the row of cherry blossom trees.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text: "Nemu-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私は……兄さんが誰を好きになってもいいっ
　て思ってた」
dialogues.en: "I don't mind if you fall in love with somebody."
dialogues.text: "I don't mind if you fall in love with somebody."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 胸が痛い。
dialogues.en: My heart aches.
dialogues.text: My heart aches.

dialogues.jp: 音夢も、胸を押さえて深く息をついている。
dialogues.en:
Nemu also takes a deep breath, clutching her hands to her
chest.
dialogues.text:
Nemu also takes a deep breath, clutching her hands to her
chest.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「白河さんでも、眞子でも……美春でも……」
dialogues.en: "Like Shirakawa-san, Mako or Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "Like Shirakawa-san, Mako or Miharu..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私は兄さんが好きだけど……兄さんが誰かを
　好きになったら、やっぱり兄妹だって諦めよ
　うって思ってた」
dialogues.en:
"I love you, but when you fall in love with somebody, I know
I have to accept my position as a sister."
dialogues.text:
"I love you, but when you fall in love with somebody, I know
I have to accept my position as a sister."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の深い碧色の瞳が、俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Nemu's deep blue eyes gaze at me.
dialogues.text: Nemu's deep blue eyes gaze at me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でも、さくらはダメ」
dialogues.en: "But, not Sakura."
dialogues.text: "But, not Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: 軽い｛めまい／眩暈｝がする。
dialogues.en: I feel a little dizzy.
dialogues.text: I feel a little dizzy.

dialogues.jp: ズキズキ、と胸が痛んだ。
dialogues.en: My heart is aching.
dialogues.text: My heart is aching.

dialogues.jp:
それは、遠まわしで、凄く分かりやすい告白だっ
た。
dialogues.en: It was a very indirect but clear confession.
dialogues.text: It was a very indirect but clear confession.

dialogues.jp: 「俺はさくらのこと――」
dialogues.en: "Sakura is..."
dialogues.text: "Sakura is..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「好きなんだよ兄さん……兄さんはさくらに惹
　かれてるの」
dialogues.en: "I know you like her... you've fallen in love with Sakura."
dialogues.text: "I know you like her... you've fallen in love with Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢ちゃん、もしかして……」
dialogues.en: "Nemu-chan, are you..."
dialogues.text: "Nemu-chan, are you..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……さくらにだけは渡さない」
dialogues.en: "I don't want to give you to Sakura."
dialogues.text: "I don't want to give you to Sakura."

dialogues.jp: 風が吹いた。
dialogues.en: The wind blows.
dialogues.text: The wind blows.

dialogues.jp: 桜の枝をざわざわ、と。
dialogues.en: The branches of cherry trees swing.
dialogues.text: The branches of cherry trees swing.

dialogues.jp: 乱れ散る。
dialogues.en: Blossoms scatter.
dialogues.text: Blossoms scatter.

dialogues.jp: それでいて、決して消えることのない花。
dialogues.en: But, the cherry blossoms still keep blooming.
dialogues.text: But, the cherry blossoms still keep blooming.

dialogues.jp:
その風と花の幻想的な光景に押されるように、
音夢が動いた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu makes a move in keeping with the extraordinary view of
the wind and the flowers.
dialogues.text:
Nemu makes a move in keeping with the extraordinary view of
the wind and the flowers.

dialogues.jp: あまりにも自然に。
dialogues.en: Very naturally.
dialogues.text: Very naturally.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私は兄さんのモノだよ」
dialogues.en: "I am yours, niisan."
dialogues.text: "I am yours, niisan."

dialogues.jp: 唇をふさがれた。
dialogues.en: She kisses my lips.
dialogues.text: She kisses my lips.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の柔らかい匂いが鼻をくすぐる。
dialogues.en: Nemu's gentle scent tickles my nose.
dialogues.text: Nemu's gentle scent tickles my nose.

dialogues.jp: 俺は身動きが出来なかった。
dialogues.en: I can't move.
dialogues.text: I can't move.

dialogues.jp:
避けようとか受け入れようとか、そんな暇さえ
なくて。
dialogues.en: I didn't have time to think whether I'd accept or avoid her.
dialogues.text: I didn't have time to think whether I'd accept or avoid her.

dialogues.jp: それが始まり。
dialogues.en: That is our beginning.
dialogues.text: That is our beginning.

dialogues.jp: それが終わり。
dialogues.en: And that is our ending.
dialogues.text: And that is our ending.

dialogues.jp: かったるいとか、そういう次元ではない――。
dialogues.en: It's not something you can call a pain.
dialogues.text: It's not something you can call a pain.

dialogues.jp: 夢ではなく現実の――。
dialogues.en: It's not a dream, it's really happening now.
dialogues.text: It's not a dream, it's really happening now.

dialogues.jp: 何かが。
dialogues.en: Something's happening.
dialogues.text: Something's happening.

dialogues.jp: ◆幕開けのキス◆
dialogues.en: ◆It starts with a kiss◆
dialogues.text: ◆It starts with a kiss◆

dialogues.jp: 桜並木で音夢と待ち合わせをする。
dialogues.en: I waited for Nemu in the row of cherry trees.
dialogues.text: I waited for Nemu in the row of cherry trees.

dialogues.jp:
さくらに対抗意識を燃やす音夢が、突然、俺の
唇を奪った。
dialogues.en:
Nemu felt competitive with Sakura over me. All of a sudden
she stole a kiss.
dialogues.text:
Nemu felt competitive with Sakura over me. All of a sudden
she stole a kiss.

dialogues.jp:
何かが終わって、何かが始まったような瞬間
だった。
dialogues.en:
It was the moment of the ending, and yet the beginning of
something.
dialogues.text:
It was the moment of the ending, and yet the beginning of
something.
